children: FTSE Russell announces the quarterly changes to the FTSE UK Index Series. All constituent changes will be applied after the close of business on Friday, 18 September 2026 and will be effective on Monday, 21 September 2026 (rankings by capitalisation are as at close of business on Tuesday, 1 September 2026):

Please note: Index review changes included within the attached files may be subject to revision until close of business Friday, 4 September 2026.  Effective Monday, 7 September, the index review changes will be considered final.  Any subsequent changes will generally only be considered in exceptional circumstances, in accordance with the FTSE Russell recalculation policy and guidelines.
